entities.title: High-score API
entities.summary: POST game, POST score and GET scores under /games/retro/rally/api/.
guarantees: Errors are JSON { error } with 400, 404, 409, 413, 422 or 500

entities.title: rally-scores tables
entities.summary: games (issued seeds) and scores (replayed matches) in D1.
guarantees: A score's id is the id of the seed it was played from
Scores are listed best first, ties oldest first (index scores_by_score)
entities.compatibility: schema.sql describes a fresh database; the live one changes only through worker/migrations/, applied by hand before merging.

entities.title: Public addresses
entities.summary: The game at /games/retro/rally/ and its scores at /games/retro/rally/scores/.
consumers: Players' bookmarks and links from icelander.net and the multiplayer page (which adds ?match=ID)
guarantees: /games/retro/rally/scores redirects to the page with a trailing slash
